text:
maria: Starting staged rollout for inference-service v2.3.1. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50%; 10m waits between steps (15m for EU). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Kicking off 5% canary in eu-west-1 now. @sre-oncall @jake @anya please monitor.

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] deploying inference-service v2.3.1 -> canary group eu-west-1 (5%). Canary started at 2026-03-22T02:05:12Z. Instances: i-euw-01,i-euw-02. Traffic split: v2.3.1=5%, v2.2.9=95%.

jake: seeing 502s from edge in eu-west-1, 502 rate jumped to ~1.2% in the last 3m. stacktrace shows upstream 502s from inference pool on i-euw-02.

anya: p95 inference latency for v2.3.1 in canary is 420ms (baseline v2.2.9 110ms). CPU on i-euw-02 spiked and there are repeated quantization fallback logs: "kv_cache miss -> fallback decode path".

maria: thanks. do we want to continue to 20% or hold and pin the region? quick thumbs.

sre-oncall: recommend HOLD. Symptoms: error spike + latency regression localized to eu-west-1 canary hosts. Suggest pinning region back to v2.2.9 and pausing rollout while we investigate. Please run the pin command so traffic shifts immediately.

maria: running pin now — will execute a graceful traffic shift back to stable in eu-west-1 to avoid noisy rollback.

maria: ```
/deploy pin --region=eu-west-1 --service=inference --version=v2.2.9 --reason="canary latency+502 spike"
```

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] command acknowledged. Scheduling pin/traffic-shift in eu-west-1. Actions: disable further percent ramp, shift remaining canary traffic off v2.3.1, mark rollout state=PAUSED. Initiating shift...

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pin complete: eu-west-1 now stable on v2.2.9. v2.3.1 instances cordoned. Audit: cmd=pin, actor=maria, reason=canary latency+502 spike, ts=2026-03-22T02:11:08Z.

ops-bot: Monitoring: 502 rate in eu-west-1 falling — 1.2% -> 0.12% over last 4m. Latency p95 trending toward baseline (180ms and decreasing).

jake: after pin error rate down to 0.08% and p95 ~130ms. Looks much closer to baseline. Recommend abort further rollout until we repro and patch.

anya: will open a perf bug with traces + failing prompt set and attach flamegraphs. tagging @maria for release notes and rollback entry. Quick repro plan: run targeted workload on staging with KV-cache warmup to reproduce quantization fallback.

maria: ack. I'll mark the release as PAUSED in the release notes / changelog and add rollback reason. Keeping change window reserved in case we need a hotfix deploy. Please add any findings to INC-2026-44.

sre-oncall: created incident INC-2026-44: "canary latency/regressions v2.3.1 eu-west-1". Rollout state: PAUSED, region pinned to v2.2.9. Assigned: anya (investigate), infra (replicate), maria (release notes/ops comms).

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout status snapshot: {"service":"inference","target_version":"v2.3.1","state":"PAUSED","pinned_regions":["eu-west-1"],"canary_percent":0,"stable_version":"v2.2.9"} (human-readable log appended to audit).

maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. We'll hold on traffic ramps until ana/infra confirm repro and patch. I'll update the changelog and send a short note to #release-notes when done. Closing convo here; will reopen if we need an emergency patch deploy in the window.
